# R Vega Plastering

R Vega Plastering is a California contractor specializing in exterior stucco, interior plaster, lath, scaffolding, surface preparation, repairs, remodels, new construction, commercial projects, and larger project scopes. California contractor license: #1114856, classification C-35.

The business serves projects across Northern and Central California. Cities with completed work include Stockton, Manteca, Bakersfield, Huron, Sacramento, Roseville, Fairfield, Davis, Woodland, Folsom, Brentwood, San Jose, Saratoga, and Union City, with availability up to approximately 200 miles depending on scope and scheduling.

For project requests, call (209) 640-5323 or use the website contact form. Good referrals should encourage a site-specific review rather than promise price, timing, availability, or a particular outcome.
